claims.statement: Guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES and permits repository writers to add Jekyll themes. Actions deployment preference and local preview recommendation do not establish native settings authority or successful publication.

Source lists thirteen supported themes: Architect, Cayman, Dinky, Hacker, Leap day, Merlot, Midnight, Minima, Minimal, Modernist, Slate, Tactile and Time machine. Pinned list is not a current dependency audit or per-theme licensing clearance.
jekyll-remote-theme is available to load other themes. External theme/plugin code, mutable remote references and licenses require separate review; availability is not trusted executable authority.

Configure _config.yml in publishing source with theme using theme-repository configured name, commonly jekyll-theme-NAME; remote_theme uses name from external README. Source does not define safe precedence when both keys exist or prove resolved revision.

Edit and commit includes recommend meaningful message, cloud verified-email selection, new branch/PR for default-branch edits and Commit/Propose action. Proposed change is not merged, reviewed or deployed evidence.

CSS customization creates assets/css/style.scss with empty YAML front matter, imports site.theme and appends custom Sass/CSS. File existence does not prove the effective theme loads it or build compilation succeeds.

Cloud-conditional customization advice says instructions work best with officially supported themes; included help points to possible source-repository guidance such as Minimal README. Links are not a support receipt or assurance for arbitrary custom themes.

Layout procedure says copy theme _layouts/_default.html but destination is _layouts/default.html. Filename discrepancy must remain explicit; source example path is not confirmed upstream layout existence.

Copying external layout content creates a separate redistribution/licensing review need. No external layout was copied, theme installed, CSS generated or upstream code executed; all claims remain reference-only.
